top_signals.title: Bloom Energy, Illumina, Everpure to Join S&P 500 This Month
top_signals.summary: Bloom Energy Corp., Illumina Inc. and Everpure Inc. will join the S&P 500 in the latest quarterly rebalance, S&P Dow Jones Indices said Friday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
